outcome: mitochondrial protein cytochrome c oxidase subunit VIc
cohort: The study included fetuses of female baboons who were fed either a normal chow diet or 70% of a control diet (moderate maternal nutrient reduction).
finding: Moderate maternal nutrient reduction differentially altered fetal renal mitochondrial gene expression in a sex-dependent manner, specifically impacting transcripts for metabolite transport and dynamics proteins and decreasing mitochondrial protein cytochrome c oxidase subunit VIc.
